value.summary: This pull request changes a single use path from `openhuman_core::openhuman as oh` to `openhuman_core as oh`.  Without a view of the crate's public module structure it is impossible to tell whether the re-export is actually present under the new path; if it is not, every reference to `oh::` will fail to compile.  Based solely on what the diff shows, there is no conclusive evidence of a bug, so the change looks sound under the assumption that the author has verified the new module path.
